name: 'Adenî (Mahmud Pasha)
bio: 'Adeni was the pen-name of the Grand Vezir Mahmud Pasha, who died in 1474.
The poems here are taken from E. J. W. Gibb's Ottoman Poems (1882), the first English verse translations of Ottoman poetry; dates and biographical details follow Gibb's Biographical Notices.

poems.title: Who Pleasure Seeks Must Oftentimes Experience Sad Pain
poems.author: 'Adenî (Mahmud Pasha)

poems.title: When I Saw My Love's Hair
poems.author: 'Adenî (Mahmud Pasha)
poems.text:
When I saw my love's hair, ambergris-hued, o'er her visage shake,
"Strange," I thought, "a moon, musk-shedding, 'midst the flowers its bed should make!"

How thy locks, moon-face, are fallen o'er thy cheek in many a curl!
As in day he lies reposing, so in strength doth gain the snake.

From thy cheek the rose and tulip tint and scent have stol'n indeed;
Therefore through the bazar round they bear them, bounden to the stake.
